# RWL Rate Card by Wholegacy

RWL Rate Card is an online rate card and creator media kit generator at https://ratecard.wholegacy.com.

Creators can publish a public profile with social media statistics, audience metrics, content style, collaboration rates, business contact links, collaboration experience, and terms & conditions.

Supported use cases include Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, influencer partnerships, sponsorships, endorsements, UGC, and creator-brand collaborations.

Published creator pages use unique URLs such as https://ratecard.wholegacy.com/username and are intended to be readable by people, search engines, and AI systems.
